fit: Himalayan raspberry consumption and blood pressure in hypertension
assessment: The five-person case series reports lower pressure over time, asymptomatic low readings in three and medication changes in two. It gives no orthostatic test, lightheadedness outcome, species assignment or frozen preparation.

fit: extra-virgin olive oil in a multidomain trial with planned anxiety scale
assessment: The protocol schedules DASS and recommends extra-virgin olive oil in a bundled lifestyle intervention. The oil processing method and standalone anxiety effect stay open, and the trial provides no posted outcome estimate.

fit: weekly egg intake and gait tests reported by osteosarcopenia status
assessment: The author abstract associates weekly egg intake with osteosarcopenia and describes gait by musculoskeletal diagnosis. The available text gives no egg-to-gait estimate or cooking detail. The full article remains gated.

fit: egg-yolk oil as adjunct in hemiplegia dysarthria
assessment: The deposited abstract reports a larger change in a broad Robertson measure with an egg-yolk-derived product. Original route, individual speech measures and full methods are open. The comparison uses hemiplegia and an oil intervention.

fit: isolated capsinoid crossover and exercise metabolism
assessment: The preprint and journal abstract report a shift toward fat oxidation after exercise and inconclusive glycogen restoration. The strongly matched registry and publications describe one likely cohort and give no participant-rated clinical fatigue estimate.

fit: extra-virgin olive oil in a multidomain trial with planned insomnia scale
assessment: Table 1 recommends extra-virgin olive oil in the MIND dietary component and the schedule includes the Insomnia Severity Index. Older adults at dementia risk are the study population. Posted outcomes and oil-specific effects remain open.
